attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Prosperity and peace in Asia, the Middle East, and Africa will only be possible when those regions are fully integrated into the global economy.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We are working to promote fair trade with Japan and China.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We are promoting regional trade, particularly among Israel, Jordan, and Egypt.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We must continue our work to reach out to moderate Arab states.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We must intensify our effort to foster closer ties to the Islamic World.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party believes in supporting what South African President Thabo Mbeki has called \"an African renaissance\".", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"South Africa is a great beacon of hope.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"We are encouraged by the restoration of democracy in Nigeria.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Botswana has a long-term continuation of a stable democratic system.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Mozambique is making courageous efforts of recovery after years of civil war.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"We see hope for the survival of the ideal of a multi-ethnic society in Zimbabwe's recent election.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The recently enacted African Growth and Opportunity Act is a major contribution toward the future.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
